notes:
This version works with AppSweet servers that have sign-in built in. A company server installed before
that asks for a server update it cannot get: its administrator installs the new server version fresh
and invites the team again.

New
- Settings → Members: invite teammates by email, resend or revoke an invitation, change a role or
  remove someone (owners and admins).
- Settings → Account security: change your name and password, and turn two-step verification with an
  authenticator app on or off, with single-use recovery codes.
